milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate toward the stone brick ruins structure and face the mossy stone bricks on its exterior walls. Target is set to [6, 1, 6] (the approximate center of the structure where mossy bricks are placed on walls at eye level). max_distance=8 allows the player to see the mossy bricks from a reasonable viewing distance without requiring them to be right on top of the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the structure rather than facing away.
